name: HSBC RedCoin
oneLiner: HSBC RedCoin (RCHKD) is HSBC's HKMA-licensed HKD stablecoin, launched on PayMe in October 2026 with no public contract or supply data yet.
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets held in segregated accounts under HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance requirements
pegMechanism: Pre-launch HKD fiat-referenced stablecoin licensed by the HKMA; expected to maintain 1:1 HKD backing with segregated high-quality liquid reserve assets and regulated mint/redemption channels once HSBC launches the business
launchPhaseDetail: HKMA-licensed stablecoin issuer FRS02, effective April 10 2026. HSBC named the token HSBC RedCoin on September 30 2026 and launched it on October 23 2026 under the ticker RCHKD, available on PayMe by HSBC (3.3M users) for peer-to-peer and merchant payments, with HSBC Digital Assets Custody providing safekeeping. HSBC plans to add wallet functionality to the HSBC HK Mobile Banking App and tokenized investment subscriptions later in 2026. 1:1 backed by HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets in segregated accounts. The launch release names no blockchain and publishes no contract, circulation or reserve figures, so Pharos tracks RCHKD pre-launch until a verifiable supply and price path exists.
